purpose: Both validators explicitly supply format checkers and URI-format fields. Silent loss of an intended assertion due to an optional ambient package appears unnecessary; product-specific choices can instead state which formats are assertions and which are annotations.
first_step: Read the owning issue and .reference/test_policy.py; rerun .reference/reproduce.py against its audited source commits. Independently accept, adapt, defer, or reject the reference. Do not merge this reference branch wholesale.

limitations: Do not turn every schema format annotation into an assertion. Riverhog's intentional shape-only/calendar boundary is excluded. Finite probes establish the selected regression boundary, not complete correctness of a URI, time or other format implementation.
The existing repository implementations are compared in disposable fixtures or copies. Validation of the reference does not establish consumer conformance, operational permission, or acceptance.
